clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells a checkout story. Asked "paper or plastic?" he always says paper.

His reasoning: plastic doesn't break down. A paper bag returns to the earth. Plastic, he says, can sit in a landfill for a billion years without disappearing.

His view: the "save the trees, use plastic" message had it backwards. Paper is the renewable one.

Years later, he points out, stores stopped handing out plastic and went back to paper, to keep it out of landfills.
